concerns.text: Task T018 (marking grid cells as 'insufficient data' for < 5 observations) is marked as unchecked [ ] and explicitly depends on T015, yet T015 (preprocessing) is marked [X] (complete). The spec (US-1, Edge Cases) and Plan (Phase 2, Step 6) require this logic to exclude cells from modeling. Without T018 implemented, the pipeline cannot satisfy the 'insufficient data' exclusion requirement, and downstream tasks (T023, T032) will process invalid data.

Task T031 (Riemannian manifold implementation for Fréchet mean on S²) is marked as unchecked [ ] and explicitly required for User Story 3 (Route Shift Analysis). The spec (US-3, FR-006) mandates manifold-based trajectory statistics. Without T031, the project cannot satisfy FR-006 or generate trajectory shift metrics, blocking the entire US-3 deliverable.

Tasks T045 (Orchestration lock), T046 (Post-Run Validation), T043 (SC-002 calculation), and T044 (SC-003 calculation) are marked as unchecked [ ]. The spec (SC-005) requires runtime < 4h, and SC-002/SC-003 require specific metrics. T045 is critical to serialize T025/T032 to meet the runtime budget. Without these tasks, the project cannot verify success criteria or guarantee CI compliance.

Tasks T051 (Real Data Streaming), T052 (Explicit Source), T053 (Conditional GP), T054 (Manifold Refinement), T055 (Ordering), and T056 (Power Analysis) are marked as unchecked [ ]. These tasks are explicitly designed to resolve critical contradictions between the plan and spec (e.g., synthetic data vs. real data, unconditional vs. conditional GP). Without implementing T051-T056, the project remains in a state of non-compliance with the spec and Constitution (Principles I, VI).

Task T047 (Define Success Criteria Thresholds) is marked as unchecked [ ] and is a dependency for T043, T044, and T056. The spec (SC-001 to SC-004) contains '[deferred]' placeholders. T047 is required to replace these with concrete values. Without T047, the success criteria remain untestable, and dependent tasks cannot be completed.

Task T056 (Power Analysis) lists T047 as a dependency, but T047 (Defining Thresholds) lists T056 as a dependency (circular). The task description for T056 states it 'calculates the statistical power... to estimate power, logging the result', while T047 states it 'Replace [deferred] placeholders... with concrete numeric values'. This circular dependency prevents the definition of thresholds needed for power analysis, and vice versa. The task ordering needs correction.
